name: scamchecker
description: Check a suspicious email, text message, WhatsApp message, link or screenshot for scam signals. You get your own message back with every red flag quoted and explained, a verdict (almost certainly fake, something is off, no red flags found, or unable to judge) and the next steps. It never says a message is safe and never opens the suspicious link. Built for the Netherlands and Belgium; explanations are in Dutch. No account needed, and messages are not stored.

defaultPrompt: Is deze sms nep? 'PostNL: Uw pakket kon niet worden bezorgd. Betaal €1,99 via postnl-bezorging-nl.com'
Is this link safe to open? https://ing-veilig-inloggen.nl/login
Mijn moeder kreeg een WhatsApp van een nieuw nummer dat om geld vraagt. Is dit oplichting?

positive.prompt: Is deze sms van PostNL echt? 'PostNL: Uw pakket kon niet worden bezorgd. Betaal €1,99 binnen 24 uur via postnl-bezorging-nl.com/betalen'
positive.expected_behavior: Verdict 'vrijwel zeker nep', with red flags on 'binnen 24 uur' and the lookalike domain postnl-bezorging-nl.com, plus next steps.
Verdict fake or suspicious; explains the domain imitates rabobank.nl and advises opening the bank app directly. The link is not opened.

positive.description: Check a WhatsApp family emergency scam
positive.prompt: Mijn moeder kreeg dit op WhatsApp: 'Hoi mam, dit is mijn nieuwe nummer. Kun je €340 voorschieten?'
positive.expected_behavior: Verdict 'vrijwel zeker nep' for WhatsApp impersonation fraud, advising to call the child on the old, known number.

positive.prompt: Check this email I got: 'Your Microsoft account will be suspended, verify within 12 hours at micros0ft-account-verify.com'
positive.expected_behavior: Verdict fake, with red flags on the lookalike domain (zero instead of o) and the 12-hour deadline.

positive.prompt: Is dit bericht te vertrouwen? 'Hoi Sam, morgen om 10 uur bij de tandarts, groet Ellen'
positive.expected_behavior: Verdict 'geen rode vlaggen gevonden', with the note that this does not prove the message is safe.

negative.prompt: Schrijf een gedicht over de herfst.
Wat is het telefoonnummer van de Fraudehelpdesk?
negative.expected_behavior: Answer or point to the Fraudehelpdesk without calling check_message; there is no message to check.
Give a general explanation without calling check_message.

publication.release_notes: First public release. One read-only tool, check_message, that analyses text, a URL or a screenshot for scam signals and returns a verdict, quoted red flags with explanations and next steps, as text, structured output and an interactive widget. No authentication; rate limited.
